summary: [CD APP] : More Options to Consider widget cards do not have rounded corners
description:
Description:
On the Model Price/Overview page, the “More options to consider” widget is not rendering with properly rounded corners on the card edges.

As visible in the attached screenshot, the widget/card corners appear sharp/square, whereas the expected UI design requires rounded corners consistent with the other cards/widgets on the page.

Steps to Reproduce:

Open the CarDekho app/PWA.
Navigate to any Model page.
Scroll to the “More options to consider” widget.
Observe the edges/corners of the cards.

Actual Result:
The card/widget edges appear sharp and are not properly rounded.

Expected Result:
The “More options to consider” cards should have properly rounded corners as per the UI design. !image-2026-08-31-11-55-30-744.png|thumbnail!
